verdicts.reason: A drops the sea photo entirely (fidelity loss), centres the logo over left-aligned copy, wraps the subcopy into a cramped 4-line column, and makes the CTA so large it competes with the headline. Even so, it is legible and well structured. B crops the photo to a useless sky sliver and puts the white logo on pale sky, where it is almost invisible. It also leaves a large empty blue band in the middle and crams the headline, copy and CTA into the bottom, with the button jammed against the bottom edge.
